HELP_ROUTE_POWER_PRODUCTION_SOLAR_MIN_DA.api_description: Solar power production data with an minute, day, month or year interval that is ordered on timestamp. Data is built in to support multiple site id’s.  Each dataset starts with a number in de range 20 – 90 (the database ID),  see the configuration page. The tens represent the specific site and the units respectively minutes (1), hours (2), days (3), months (4) and years (5). Examples: site 1 minute value is 21, site 1 hour value is 22, site 2 minute value is 31, site 2 hour value is 32 etc.  The {power_source_id} is a number,  for example for Solar Edge this is 1
